name: Amberstill Ranch
summary: North of Gol'Bolar Quarry, Amberstill Ranch stands along the snowy road to Loch Modan. The Amberstill family tends its mountain rams and guards them from hungry predators.

sections.title: Home of the Mountain Rams
sections.body: Across Khaz Modan, Amberstill Ranch is known for its strong mountain rams. The Amberstill family tends the stables and paddocks, training the sure-footed beasts for snowy passes and steep cliffs. The ranch supplies riding mounts and livestock. Wendigos drawn to the flock threaten the herd, and the family must fend them off.

faq.q: What is Amberstill Ranch known for?
faq.answer: Amberstill Ranch breeds Barak Tor'ol mountain rams for the Alliance. Dwarves and honored Alliance champions come to learn ram riding and buy mounts from the stable masters.

Rams are traditionally for dwarven riders who know their stubborn nature. Riders of other Alliance races can learn to ride and buy one only after earning Ironforge's utmost trust and exalted standing.

faq.q: What threats does the ranch face?
faq.answer: Wendigos descend from the frozen bluffs and threaten the herd. Vagash, a massive wendigo, is the most notorious predator on the surrounding heights and regularly targets the livestock.

faq.q: Can you obtain anything else at the ranch?
faq.answer: Young Yarlyn Amberstill keeps domestic snowshoe rabbits and sells them in crates to travelers seeking a companion for the road.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can acquire your first Barak Tor'ol ram mount at Amberstill Ranch.
For the Alliance, the Amberstill family's sturdy rams provide dependable cold-weather cavalry for rugged mountain terrain.
